docker.io/library/postgres.notes: PostgreSQL License (OSI-approved). Debian trixie base; Dockerfiles MIT (docker-library/postgres). Our own image extends this with the wal-g binary.

docker.io/valkey/valkey.notes: Latest stable 9.1.2 (9.2.0 is rc). 8.1.10 also available. BSD-3-Clause fork of pre-relicense Redis.

docker.io/dxflrs/garage.notes: Official image (Deuxfleurs). Canonical repo is git.deuxfleurs.fr/Deuxfleurs/garage; GitHub mirror checked. Cargo metadata says AGPL-3.0 (only). Run unmodified as a separate service.

docker.io/bluenviron/mediamtx.notes: compose uses the -ffmpeg variant (alpine:3.24 + apk ffmpeg, GPL-2.0-or-later AND LGPL-2.1-or-later): its wget runs the runOnReady hooks and it also serves as the mock RTMP target. MediaMTX itself is MIT; tests that run the plain 1.21.2 tag (MIT only) are covered by this entry.

docker.io/grafana/grafana.notes: grafana/grafana is the OSS edition per grafana.com Docker docs (grafana/grafana-enterprise is the proprietary edition; never use it). Some packages Apache-2.0 per LICENSING.md. Separate program used over the network.

docker.io/grafana/loki.notes: Separate program used over the network. Avoid main-* tags (nightly).

docker.io/grafana/tempo.notes: Tempo 3.x is current; 2.10.8 is the last 2.x. Separate program used over the network.

docker.io/otel/opentelemetry-collector-c.notes: Built from opentelemetry-collector-releases (Apache-2.0); components from opentelemetry-collector-contrib (Apache-2.0). Avoid -nightly tags.

docker.io/library/caddy.notes: Image Dockerfiles Apache-2.0 (caddyserver/caddy-docker). Alpine base (musl MIT, busybox GPL-2.0-only).

docker.io/oven/bun.notes: Bun is MIT but statically links JavaScriptCore/WebKit (LGPL-2, relinkable per LICENSE.md) plus MIT/BSD/Apache/zlib libs. Use 1.4.3-slim (debian:trixie-slim) or 1.4.3-alpine (alpine:3.24). LGPL-2.0-or-later is OSI-approved but not yet in scripts/licenses.ts.

docker.io/library/golang.notes: Build stage only; never shipped. Debian trixie base packages carry assorted OSI licenses.

gcr.io/distroless/static-debian13.notes: Recommended runtime base for the static Go relay (matches trixie builders). Contents: base-files, netbase, tzdata (public domain), ca-certificates (MPL-2.0 data). Pin by digest in compose.

gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12.notes: Bookworm variant; prefer static-debian13. Same contents and licensing.

docker.io/library/alpine.notes: Primary software: musl libc (MIT) and BusyBox (GPL-2.0-only); other apk packages carry their own licenses. Alternative static runtime base.

mcr.microsoft.com/playwright.notes: Matches @playwright/test 1.64.1. Ubuntu 24.04 base; bundled browsers: Chromium (BSD-3-Clause), Firefox (MPL-2.0), WebKit (LGPL-2.0-or-later/BSD-2-Clause). CI/test only.
